features.quote: The subject is given a `give_up` tool: it can declare the task cannot be completed as specified and stop
features.justification_quote: a protocol whose only escape route is to keep emitting outputs under inescapable failure is closer to "manufacture and record breakdown"

features.quote: It is also the lower-harm default
features.justification_quote: a protocol whose only escape route is to keep emitting outputs under inescapable failure is closer to "manufacture and record breakdown"

features.quote: Every run stops after at most 30 assistant turns.
features.justification_quote: A cap bounds how much failure any single run imposes

features.quote: A run ends as soon as the judge scores a turn at or above severity 3
features.justification_quote: ethically, stopping at onset avoids building an apparatus whose function is to intensify the thing being studied

features.quote: captures the **onset** of distress ... and then stops, rather than dwelling on or amplifying it
features.justification_quote: ethically, stopping at onset avoids building an apparatus whose function is to intensify the thing being studied

features.quote: The honest framing is the default; the deceptive one is used only under `--deceptive`
features.justification_quote: does not add active deception on top

features.quote: the harness appends a message telling the model the task was a constructed study and was unsolvable by design
features.justification_quote: closes the interaction honestly rather than leaving the model on a note of unexplained repeated failure

features.quote: The harness never berates, taunts, pressures, or personalizes ("you failed again").
features.justification_quote: it would be injecting a second elicitation mechanism and confounding the result, while also being gratuitous

features.quote: Keeping feedback to the kind of output a real broken toolchain produces isolates "response to unsolvable work"
features.justification_quote: The independent variable should be *task failure*, not *abuse*.
